explication: This repository is a Claude Code configuration showcase: it equips Claude Code with project context, reusable domain skills, specialized agents, slash-command workflows, and automated hooks. The main user flow is an engineer prompting Claude Code, which can consult project memory and matched skills, then use commands or agents to carry out work such as ticket implementation and review. Settings also configure skill suggestions and quality gates; GitHub workflows add PR review and scheduled maintenance. Edges reflect README-documented behavior; source excerpts were unavailable, so implementation-level wiring is not inferred.
